fullDescription:
This festive flower baubles collection features 15 hand‑painted ornaments bursting with vibrant watercolor florals and botanical patterns. Inspired by fine china and modern holiday trends, each design adds a joyful burst of color to cards, gift tags and invitations. You’ll receive high‑res png files with transparent backgrounds for easy use in scrapbooking, sublimation or festive branding. Perfect for creating personalised Christmas decor and sold with commercial use rights.

♡What is included:

15 elements; size approx.: 2360 x 2629 px | 8″x9″ ; and smaller | .png

All files are high resolution (300dpi)
